newsitem.title: USA: Indonesian officials visit U.S. software firms.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian officials visit U.S. software firms.

text.p: Nine Indonesian government officials will visit the United States on a computer software buying mission, the U.S. Trade and Development Agency said Friday.
The officials will plan to visit software companies in Boston, Washington, D.C., Seattle, Wash., and Silicon Valley, Calif, from December 2-13, the agency said.

"With a projected export market of $20 million to $30 million in software sales expected during the next few years in Indonesia, this visit will introduce key Indonesian buying officials to the state-of-the-art technology and position U.S. firms for export success," agency Director Joseph Grandmaison said in a statement.
The U.S. Trade and Development agency is an independent federal agency that helps U.S. companies pursue overseas business opportunities.
